name: Asakura Saori
source:
She is the younger sister of Reika, who was the secretary to a previous late president.
Saori is beautiful and an honor student with a likeable character. She is Masato's (the hero) classmate and one of the candidates for "sex-slave secretary" to Masato.
She will accept to become his "sex-slave secretary" in order to achieve something......
